Hi jidanni

I believe your example falls within the wider milestone aimed at providing / improving in-app notifications. https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-android/issues/8831

TB have noted that improving notifications is a priority and an area of active development. https://roadmaps.thunderbird.net/en-US/android/

I see you have also raised your point on Github. https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-android/issues/11300

You can keep an eye on the release notes as and when these changes make their way to beta/stable releases.
